newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Cardoso signs new corporate tax law.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Cardoso signs new corporate tax law.

text.p: Brazilian President Fernando Henrique Cardoso signed a bill creating new corporate tax rules that make it harder to evade taxes and that bring Brazil's system up to international standards, officials said.

The new law, which comes into effect next year, seeks to streamline the Brazilian tax system and widen its base of contributors. Businesses will pay tax on a quarterly basis instead of monthly, as they now do.
The law also aims to close loopholes that have allowed multinationals in Brazil to pay less tax by exaggerating the value of imported goods and undervaluing exports.

But a decree to be issued Monday will reduce to zero from a current 15 percent tax rates on several categories of movement of cash overseas, reducing the burden on the multinationals, an official with the Tax Secretariat said.
